newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ATHLETICS-RUSSIANS LOOK TO ATHENS WITH CONFIDENCE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-RUSSIANS LOOK TO ATHENS WITH CONFIDENCE.

text.p: Team chief Vadim Zelechonok said on Wednesday he was confident Russia would do well at next month's world athletics championships and improve on their showing at Malmo two years ago.

Zelechonok was speaking on the second day of the national championships which have been marked by a lack of records with most of the best athletes absent having already been chosen for Athens following last month' s European Cup.

Zelechonok named the best medal chances for Athens as Maxim Tarasov (pole vault), Natalya Sadovaya (discus), Oksana Ovchinnikova (javelin), Denis Kapustin (triple jump) and Svetlana Laukhova (100 metres hurdles).
"Altogether we shall have about 80 athletes going," he said.
